name: Kuchiki Fumiya
source:
Young Fumiya. A kind, quiet boy who accompanied his sister [url=/c11266]Chizuru[/url] to the Hitogata Settlement from Tokyo. 

He’s studying to become a surgeon to follow in his father’s footsteps. 

"Chizuru, it’s almost time for your check-up."

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]
